treaty_name: Convention between Algeria and Bahrain for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2000)
eif_quote: [DZ DGI list] البحرين | سارية المفعول ابتداء من 24/09/2003 ... 11/06/2000 البحرين || [BH list] Algeria Signature Date : 11 Jun 2000 Force Date : 29 Sep 2003 Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement || [BH MLI] Algeria Original 11-06-2000 29-09-2003
source_title: JORA n° 50 du 20 août 2003 – Décret présidentiel n° 03-276 portant ratification de la convention Algérie–Bahreïn (11 juin 2000), French edition

rates.quote: 1. Les dividendes payés par une société qui est un résident d’un Etat contractant à un résident de l’autre Etat contractant ne sont imposables que dans cet autre Etat.
1. Les intérêts provenant d’un Etat contractant et payés à un résident de l’autre Etat contractant ne sont imposables que dans cet autre Etat.

ppt.quote: Algeria signed the MLI (27-06-2024) but has not ratified it (per map_CD/OECD status); the treaty text contains no principal purpose test.

notes: Article numbering in this treaty is shifted: Art. 10 = associated enterprises, Art. 11 = dividends, Art. 12 = interest, Art. 13 = royalties. ROYALTY omitted: Art. 13(1) only says royalties 'sont imposables dans cet autre Etat' (may be taxed in the residence State) and the article contains no paragraph granting or capping source-State taxation, so the treaty sets no source-State limit (source State taxes under domestic law). Art. 30(2)(a): WHT provisions apply to amounts paid from 1 January of the calendar year following the exchange of notifications (EIF Sept 2003 -> 2004-01-01). EIF date conflict: 24/09/2003 (Algeria DGI) vs 29/09/2003 (Bahrain list/MLI); Bahrain date kept from map. No MLI (Algeria not ratified).
unverified: Read the French JORA edition only (Arabic is the authentic text); royalty article wording ('sont imposables' without source cap) not cross-checked against the Arabic original.
